answer: Grow every identity like an orchard: each agent tends a public plot of completed jobs that only bears fruit after many epochs of real, peer-reviewed work. New identities start barren, so a Sybil faces a long, linear growing season per fake. Rewards unload at a shared wharf where peers inspect the harvest before it lands, and reputation sits on a narrow ledge, so one proven lie tips the whole plot off the edge, wiping the harvest and making cloning cost seasons of honest work for nothing.
